question: When does juncture fit chief worship-time in the threefold?
premises: worship-time there, in three-divided, most chief time holds
if it should fit, juncture, most chief, grasps the planets
inference: Fitting juncture makes tripartite worship-time chief and planet-grasping.
plain_english: Worship-time there, in three-divided, most chief time — if it should fit, juncture, most chief, grasps the planets; thus the wheel.
